# Icon identifiers

* Items below are sorted alphabetically and never reflect the sorting in the
  TYPO3 backend.
* If a group has only one sub-item, then the sub-item's icon isn't displayed9.
* Group-icons look fundamentally different, as they have no squared colored
  background-color.
* Some icons aren't displayed directly in the module-sidebar but in different
  locations.
* The amount of displayed icons depends on the installed extensions and the
  user's access-level in TYPO3 in combination with the administrator's
  configuration. Administrators see all icons usually, if they are also
  registered maintainers.

## Module Group Icon identifiers

* modulegroup-file, transparent
* modulegroup-help, transparent
* modulegroup-site, transparent
* modulegroup-system, transparent,, System
* modulegroup-tools, transparent,, Administration
* modulegroup-user, transparent
* modulegroup-web, transparent
